preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root of the AVL tree is either a TreeNode or None.

postconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
postconditions.description: The root of the tree is either None or a TreeNode.
The tree remains a valid AVL tree after each insertion.
